exemplars.title: Traceable Texts and Their Effects: A Study of Summary-Source Links in AI-Generated Summaries
exemplars.why: Hovering a summary phrase highlights its mapped source passages, exposing a stable output-to-evidence correspondence at the exact moment a reader may want to verify the generated claim. It is a particularly clear exemplar of the catalogue’s source-output extension of Linked Views.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above rid 2553 because the maintained correspondence is the system’s central object of study and is directly tied to verification, rather than serving mainly to contextualize feedback.

exemplars.title: Generating Automatic Feedback on UI Mockups with Large Language Models
exemplars.why: Clicking a link in textual feedback selects the same UI object in both the visual mockup and the Layers panel. This gives a complete trigger–identity mapping–coordinated response across three differently encoded regions and turns abstract critique into inspectable context.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above rid 10239 because coordinating feedback, canvas content, and structural hierarchy demonstrates the pattern across three complementary regions with a broader diagnostic and actionability benefit.

exemplars.title: CodeVoyager: Integrating Interactive Visual Aids with LLMs for Code Comprehension
exemplars.why: A code entity appears simultaneously as a call-graph node and a source segment, and selecting the node highlights the mapped code automatically. The quote supplies the complete structural signature in a canonical, highly transferable form.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above rid 13643 because it unambiguously renders the same code entity in two synchronized views, whereas GenTune’s image-element-to-prompt-label relationship is a more specialized causal mapping supported only by abstract-level evidence.

notes: I departed from the consensus by excluding second-ranked rid 13643 and promoting fourth-ranked rid 10239. GenTune would receive an effective score of about 4.15—a downward adjustment greater than 0.3—because an image element and its causal prompt labels are not clearly two renderings of the same underlying item, and the available evidence comes only from the abstract. The selected scores differ from their consensus means by less than 0.3. Evidence limitations remain: rid 8598 uses the pattern’s explicitly flagged source-output extension rather than its strict same-item form; rid 2553 is supported by a figure caption and its feedback link is not itself another rendering of the UI object, although the coordinated canvas and Layers selections are; and rid 10239 is structurally strong but represents an established graph-to-source interaction rather than a novel design move.
